name: claude-handoff-skills
description: Skills for long-running, multi-session agent work: writing and trimming handoff docs, and briefing subagents rigorously enough to verify what comes back.

plugins.name: handoff-docs
plugins.description: Write and maintain a HANDOFF.md so the next agent or human can resume a multi-session project with zero prior context. Includes write-handoff (produce and update the doc from real repo state, not memory) and trim-handoff (archive closed-work sections once the doc outgrows itself). Pure markdown instructions, no dependencies.

plugins.name: subagent-brief
plugins.description: Write rigorous, repeatable briefs for subagents and verify what comes back. Enforces a fixed brief template, explicit risk-tier grants, worktree isolation for writers, a strict JSON result schema with evidence, secrets scanning, pilot runs with early stop for batches, and an auditable run log. Requires Python 3.8+ and git; standard library only.
